careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

eExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

uExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

rExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

eExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

uExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

sExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

aExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

.Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

oExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

uExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

eExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |

careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

lExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

rExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

rExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

RExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

dExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

rExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

aExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

LExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

rExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

oExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

aExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

0Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

5Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one

fExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

uExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

nExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

aExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

dExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

rExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

aExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

iExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

TExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

nExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

1Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

oExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| - | - | - | - | - | - |

| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

 Extraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| Cinder Works, 8 raids | Extracted | Engagements | Flushes | Alarms (birds, barks) | Robots sent |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

iExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:

| with animals | 4 of 8 | 49 | 87 | 8, 2 | 0 |
| without | 3 of 8 | 62 | | | |

The difference was noise. The animals don't change how raids go for a
careful bot; they change what a player can read, and what a careless one
pays for.

lExtraction 7 of 16 with, 8 of 16 without; raid times the same. Bots set
off a flock every minute or so and raise the alarm once or twice a raid,
but no robot was ever sent by birds: a robot has to be within 60 m of the
flock you put up, and a careful raider isn't. Engagements went up in
three valleys and down in one, so Cinder Works (26 against 13) was run
again at eight raids each way, logging the dogs' barks too:
